Name: Leah's Sculptures as Furniture
Author: pheauxm
Description:
After viewing the in-town art show version of Leah's 8-heart event, you will receive a letter and be able to purchase (replicas of) Leah's named sculptures from Robin. The sculptures are the woman sculpture, 'Post-Dimensional Nullspace', and 'Egg Heads' (note that 'Egg Heads' is currently unanimated); I excluded 'Wood Sculpture 3' since it's the same sprite as the sculpture she gifts you in her 6-heart event.

The art show event ID is 53 if you want to use console commands to mark it as seen because you chose a different route for her 8-heart event, or simply want to get the sculptures earlier.

The sprites for the furniture come directly from the sprites in TileSheets/Cursors, so if another mod changes their appearances in that file, then the furniture should match.

1.0.1 adds translations for the sculptures, copied from the event, and removes (Replica) so they're more in line with existing furniture names.
